newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Faulding in talks with Cardinal.
newsitem.headline: Faulding in talks with Cardinal.

text.p: Australian pharmaceutical company F.H Faulding and Co Ltd said on Monday it was holding talks with United States' healthcare company Cardinal Health Inc about the Australian distribution of Cardinal's automated hospital pharmacy dispensary and information systems.

Faulding Healthcare chief operating officer David Murphy said decisions regarding automation technology in Australian hospitals were imminent in many instances and the joint venture would be able to offer world class and proven systems to the industry in the near future.
The discussions were expected to be concluded in the next few weeks and Faulding envisaged that pilot sites would be chosen immediately, he said.

The statement said Cardinal, which has annual revenue of more than US$10 billion, was the United States' larget manufacturer of automated pharmaceutical and supply dispensing systems with installations in about 2,000 hospitals.
